title: AI Chatbots in Consumer Finance: What the CFPB Spotlight Named and Who Enforces It in 2026
summary: The CFPB's 2023 chatbot spotlight named real failure modes, and they did not disappear when the Bureau pulled back. The doom loop, missed federal rights, and UDAAP exposure, who enforces them now, and the controls that hold up.
